title: dissect_ntlmssp_blob assigns result->length before the MAX_BLOB_SIZE check, so an oversized blob leaves the length large while contents was never allocated for it
consumer: epan/dissectors/packet-ntlmssp.c:983-989 (the write) and :1649 (the consumer that trusts the length)
object: result->contents, a wmem FILE scope chunk carved from a block g_malloc handed out
lifetime_ender: NONE -- the object is alive throughout. This is a SPATIAL row.
shape: the metadata overstates the allocation: `result->length = blob_length` runs unconditionally, then `if (blob_length < MAX_BLOB_SIZE)` guards the allocation, so for an oversized blob the struct claims a length its buffer does not have and a later memcpy at offset 32 reads past it
allocator_layer: wmem, a chunk the BLOCK or BLOCK_FAST allocator carved from a block g_malloc handed out. An inner allocator carved the crossed region, so under this inventory's axis -- WHO ALLOCATED THE OBJECT -- this row IS NESTED.
nested_why: an inner allocator (wmem) carved the crossed region out of a larger block it had itself obtained from g_malloc, so under this inventory's axis -- WHO ALLOCATED THE OBJECT -- this row IS NESTED.
fidelity: real allocator, model consumer. MAX_BLOB_SIZE is 256 and the earlier, smaller blob is 24 bytes -- the reachable case, since the struct is per-conversation and reused. The case asserts that the recorded length exceeds what was allocated, that the consumer's `> 24` threshold admits it, and that the read at offset 32 is past the chunk yet inside the block.
live_proof: read from the PINNED source: v4.6.8:epan/dissectors/packet-ntlmssp.c contains the fixed `tvb_memdup(wmem_file_scope(), tvb, blob_offset, blob_length)` 1 time and the pre-fix unconditional `result->length = blob_length;` before the size check 0 times. Two-sided. A fix-reversal.
distinguishing: the only row in this corpus where the crossing is a consumer CORRECTLY TRUSTING a field that was written too early, rather than an index arithmetic error. The fix does not clamp anything -- it moves one assignment inside the check so the two can no longer disagree. Distinct from rows 14, 20 and 21, where the index or the length is itself wrong.
